<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:#05070d;color:#fff;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}
.wrap{max-width:850px;margin:auto;padding:12px}
.card{margin:12px 0;padding:16px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#121826,#080b12);border:1px solid #303746;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 12px 35px #0009}

.note{font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;color:#aaa;text-align:center}
button{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:15px;margin-top:11px;font-size:17px;font-weight:800}
.pay{background:#ffd43b;color:#111}
.share{background:#25d366;color:#fff}
.wa{background:#128c7e;color:#fff}
#ok{display:none;background:#132719;color:#91f0a5;padding:12px;border-radius:10px;margin-top:10px}
</style>
</head>
